resolved_items.title: Controlled and random ablation evidence
resolved_items.non_claim: Ablation evidence does not establish general-purpose language-model quality or scientific conclusions beyond the declared experiment.

resolved_items.title: Public-safe real-model evidence summaries
resolved_items.non_claim: Original local checkpoints and dataset binaries remain outside Git.

resolved_items.title: LM_GENERALIZATION_V2/V3 paired-seed generalization experiments
resolved_items.non_claim: V2 and V3 show preliminary positive support but V4 is mixed/falsified for a universal regularization effect; the combined small synthetic evidence does not establish robust out-of-distribution generalization or mature general-purpose capability.

resolved_items.title: Governed retrieval gate robustness evaluation
resolved_items.non_claim: The result is bounded to synthetic adversarial fixtures and does not establish semantic truth or convert score into authority.

resolved_items.title: Governed model-swap continuity measurement
resolved_items.non_claim: A fixed synthetic-state model swap is descriptive evidence only; it does not establish identity, subjectivity, consciousness, phenomenal continuity or authority.

resolved_items.title: Temporal continuity lexical-carryover falsification
resolved_items.non_claim: A negative result against simple lexical carryover in one synthetic contrast does not establish non-lexical continuity, identity, subjectivity or consciousness.

remaining_items.title: Formal G1-Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 baseline and benchmark
remaining_items.reason: The declared external baseline weights/runtime were unavailable under the local compute and dependency constraints; scratch models were not substituted.

remaining_items.title: Scratch language model held-out and compositional generalization
remaining_items.reason: V2 and V3 fixed synthetic splits with paired seeds show positive regularization improvements (V2 minimum 0.028870105743408203; V3 minimum 0.028661489486694336), but the results remain preliminary and do not establish robust out-of-distribution generalization or mature general-purpose capability.

remaining_items.title: Mature general-purpose AION language model usability
remaining_items.reason: A mature general-purpose model claim is not established by the current small synthetic-corpus research checkpoints.

remaining_items.title: Required-model completeness across all future AION/Astra capabilities
remaining_items.reason: The current reconciliation closes known local model evidence but does not prove that every future capability has a complete learned-model requirement specification.

remaining_items.title: Live private cross-session memory service
remaining_items.reason: A live private service, data policy and owner-approved operational boundary are outside this local research reconciliation.

remaining_items.title: Canonical AION/Astra runtime promotion
remaining_items.reason: Research integration remains non-canonical; no promotion decision is made in this task.

remaining_items.title: Production deployment
remaining_items.reason: Deployment is explicitly outside this task and remains DEPLOYMENT=FALSE.

remaining_items.title: Independent IV&V
remaining_items.reason: Independent review by a party separate from the implementer has not been achieved.

remaining_items.title: Subjectivity, identity and relational conclusions
remaining_items.reason: Current engineering evidence does not establish these scientific conclusions and no such claim is made.

remaining_items.title: Network MCP transport
remaining_items.reason: The current candidate intentionally does not enable network MCP transport; in-process evidence is not network completion.

remaining_items.title: Twin embodiment, visual assets, sensation and sexuality-related scope
remaining_items.reason: The formal reconciliation explicitly prohibits beginning new sexuality research or new product/runtime scope.

remaining_items.title: Final repository license selection
remaining_items.reason: License selection is an Owner-held repository governance decision and is not silently inferred from component metadata.

remaining_items.title: Checkpoint and dataset binary redistribution policy
remaining_items.reason: Binaries are intentionally absent from Git; future redistribution requires explicit license, privacy, security and repository-policy review.
